plays.desc_ko: 미드 라인전 초반 루키(사일러스)가 쵸비(아리)를 상대로 공격적으로 딜교환을 시도했고, 해설은 사일러스에게 잘 풀리고 있다고 말함. 다만 직후 쵸비가 CS를 챙기며 작은 이득을 쌓는다는 평가가 이어짐. 같은 구간에 봇에서 듀로·룰러도 공격적으로 나섰다는 짧은 언급이 있음.
plays.desc_en: Rookie (Sylas) trades aggressively into Chovy (Ahri) early in lane and looks to be doing well, though Chovy quietly builds a small edge through CS. Duro and Ruler are also briefly noted playing aggressively in the bot lane.
plays.quote: Rookie playing this one very ... aggressively and it's working out really ... already six CS for Chovy

plays.desc_ko: 캐니언(리 신)이 녹턴과의 정글 교전을 피하고 탑 쪽으로 이동. 이후 해설은 캐니언이 봇을 밀러 가지 않아 동선이 효율적이었고 탑 쪽 바위게로 갔을 것이라고 회고함.
plays.desc_en: Canyon (Lee Sin) avoids a jungle skirmish with Nocturne and heads topside, with the casters later noting his efficient pathing toward the top Scuttle Crab instead of pushing bot.
plays.quote: looks like Canyon's just going to fly up ... top lane, not look to contest the ... gone top side for the Scuttle Crab

plays.desc_ko: 웨이(녹턴)가 봇으로 합류해 지아치(루시안)·메이코(밀리오)와 함께 룰러(애쉬)·듀로(세라핀)를 공격. 듀로의 E(비트 드롭)가 메이코에게 맞았지만 룰러는 배리어와 점멸을 모두 사용했고, 지아치도 점멸로 추격했으나 마지막 평타 사거리에 닿지 못함. 녹턴 궁극기(어둠) 속에서 듀로는 주문 방어막을 벗겨낸 뒤 내부 포탑 아래로 살아서 도착. 결과적으로 룰러 점멸·배리어 소모, 젠지 봇 미니언 손실.
plays.desc_en: Wei (Nocturne) joins JiaQi (Lucian) and Meiko (Milio) to dive Ruler (Ashe) and Duro (Seraphine); Duro's Beat Drop lands on Meiko, but Ruler burns Barrier and Flash while JiaQi's Flash chase falls just short. Duro strips a spell shield inside Paranoia and reaches the inner turret alive, leaving GEN down summoners and a bot wave.
plays.quote: Beatdrop does connect here ... trouble has to use THE BARRIER ... FLASH FROM JACHI THOUGH is not quite

plays.desc_ko: 해설이 캐니언이 탑 쪽으로 텔레포트(혹은 귀환 후 텔레포트)한다고 언급하며, 이번 게임 캐니언이 점멸 대신 탈진·텔레포트를 들었다고 설명.
plays.desc_en: Canyon teleports toward top, possibly after recalling, with the casters noting he took Exhaust and Teleport instead of Flash this game.
plays.quote: we do have Canyon just ... teleporting back towards that top side

plays.desc_ko: 루키가 봇 쪽 시야선 뒤로 젠지가 우회해 들어올 각을 막기 위해 즉시 와드를 설치. 웨이도 봇 쪽으로 이동해 캐니언의 봇 개입을 막고 압박을 유지하려 함.
plays.desc_en: Rookie immediately wards behind the bot-side sightline to deny a GEN flank, while Wei moves bot to keep pressure and block Canyon from intervening.
plays.quote: a nice ward from Rookie though ... So already even Way shifting in here

plays.desc_ko: 점멸·배리어가 없는 룰러를 상대로 IG 봇 듀오가 계속 딜교환에서 이김. 듀로의 좋은 무빙으로 룰러는 살았지만 라인에서는 밀린다는 서술. 이후에도 메이코·지아치가 2대2 주도권을 쥐고 있다는 언급이 반복됨.
plays.desc_en: With Ruler lacking Flash and Barrier, IG's bot duo keeps winning trades; Duro's movement keeps him alive but GEN gets pushed around, as Meiko and JiaQi hold 2v2 priority.
plays.quote: But they continue to win these trades ... there's no flash no barrier on Ruler ... that's a great side step there

plays.title_ko: 탑 웨이브 정리 후 귀환 취소
plays.desc_ko: 더샤이(럼블)가 궁극기(이퀄라이저)로 탑 웨이브를 정리하고 귀환하려 했으나, 해설 직후 귀환을 취소함.
plays.desc_en: TheShy (Rumble) clears the top wave with The Equalizer and starts to recall, but cancels it shortly after.
plays.quote: top side just to clear out this wave for ... The Shy trying to get as much tempo ... see although cancels it as soon as I

plays.desc_ko: 웨이가 업그레이드 강타를 가진 상태로 견제 없는 첫 드래곤을 혼자 처치하러 감. 이후 해설은 이 드래곤으로 녹턴 6레벨을 찍고 봇 다이브를 노렸다고 서술.
plays.desc_en: Wei, holding upgraded Smite, solos the uncontested first dragon, which the casters say brought Nocturne to level 6 for a bot dive.
plays.quote: Way moving over ... I think it's just an uncontested dragon ... level six hit for Nocturne off of this

plays.desc_ko: 6레벨이 된 웨이(녹턴)가 봇으로 와서 IG 봇 듀오와 강하게 딜교환·다이브를 시도. 녹턴 궁극기로 '불이 꺼지고' 듀로가 점멸로 피했지만 퍼스트 블러드가 지아치에게 돌아감.
plays.desc_en: A level 6 Wei (Nocturne) arrives bot to trade and dive with IG's duo; the lights go out with Paranoia, and although Duro flashes away, JiaQi gets First Blood.
plays.quote: And they're really trying to hard trade ... dragon to look for a dive on bot ... the lights go out

plays.desc_ko: IG의 봇 다이브와 동시에 캐니언이 탑으로 가 기인(그웬)과 함께 더샤이를 노림. 더샤이에게 탈진이 걸렸고 기인의 니들워크(Q)가 빗나가 더샤이가 '일단은' 생존. 기인이 합류하고 캐니언이 빠져나갈 길을 막으려 하지만 이 구간에서 결과는 서술되지 않음.
plays.desc_en: As IG dives bot, Canyon ganks top with Kiin (Gwen) on TheShy; TheShy is Exhausted but survives for now as Kiin's Snip Snip! misses, with Kiin and Canyon trying to cut off his escape.
plays.quote: is trying to beat them to the punch by ... looking for the Shy ... THE SHY GETTING EXHAUSTED IN THIS TOP

plays.desc_ko: 퍼스트 블러드 이후 IG가 봇 포탑 아래 룰러를 계속 다이브. 메이코가 포탑 어그로를 받아 웨이를 살렸지만, 마나가 없던 지아치는 스킬을 쓰지 못했고 룰러가 배리어로 버팀. 결국 메이코와 지아치가 쓰러지고 룰러는 생존해 '실패한 포탑 다이브'로 정리됨.
plays.desc_en: IG keeps diving Ruler under the bot turret; Meiko tanks turret aggro to save Wei, but a manaless JiaQi can't use abilities and Ruler holds on with Barrier. Meiko and JiaQi fall while Ruler survives in a failed dive.
plays.quote: this still could be a very dangerous ... THEY LOOK FOR IT AS MEIKO IS GOING ... RULER IS STILL ALIVE

plays.desc_ko: 포탑 다이브를 받던 룰러가 배리어와 침착한 대기로 버티고, 듀로의 W(서라운드 사운드) 보호 지원으로 반격해 메이코와 지아치를 잡아내며 상황을 뒤집음. 해설은 '젠지의 엄청난 아웃플레이'라고 표현.
plays.desc_en: Ruler stalls the dive with Barrier and calm positioning, and with Duro's Surround Sound support they turn it around to take down Meiko and JiaQi in what the casters call a huge GEN outplay.
plays.quote: AND JACKEYLOVE IS DEAD AS WELL. GENG ... WITH A SICK OUTPLAY BOTTOM LANE ... THEY TURNED THE PLAY AROUND

plays.desc_ko: 봇에서 물러난 IG가 탑의 기인을 노림(해설: 'TP'ing top'). 더샤이가 이퀄라이저로 웨이브를 정리하고 기인은 W(안개)로 버팀. 웨이의 패러노이아와 공포가 들어갔지만, 포탑 아래에서 피해를 너무 많이 받은 루키가 기인에게 잡혀 1대1 교환으로 끝남.
plays.desc_en: IG turns to Kiin top; TheShy clears with The Equalizer while Kiin holds with Hallowed Mist, and Wei lands Paranoia and fear, but Rookie, badly hurt under turret, gets taken down by Kiin for a one-for-one.
plays.quote: they're just TP'ing top ... Let's try and look for Keen ... The paranoia

plays.desc_ko: 탑 교전 직후 쵸비도 텔레포트로 탑에 합류해 무언가(이어지는 문장이 가려짐)를 챙김. 해설은 젠지가 IG의 공세를 흡수하며 우위를 넓힌다고 서술.
plays.desc_en: Chovy also teleports top after the fight, as GEN absorbs IG's aggression and extends its lead.
plays.quote: And Chovy even TP's top to catch the

plays.desc_en: Despite missing a few Snip Snip!s, Kiin shoves waves into TheShy, leaving him able only to clear, as the Gwen counterpick secures top priority.
plays.quote: does miss a couple of those needle ... have this wave shoved in towards him

plays.desc_ko: IG가 무언가를 시도해 들어왔고(앞 문장 잘림) 웨이(녹턴)가 앞으로 진입했지만 쵸비의 매혹에 걸림. 젠지는 녹턴이 거기 있을 것을 예상하고 있었다는 회고.
plays.desc_en: IG commits and Wei (Nocturne) charges forward, only to be hit by Chovy's Charm, with GEN having anticipated Nocturne's position.
plays.quote: comes through, but there is the counter ... Way goes on forward, gets charmed up ... They had an idea that Nocturne was

plays.desc_en: GEN counters instantly: Chovy's Charm, Canyon's Safeguard and Duro's ultimate take down Wei, Ruler's Enchanted Crystal Arrow hits Meiko, Duro adds Beat Drop, and Canyon goes after JiaQi for a double kill while Rookie dodges and survives.
plays.quote: that is Canyon locking DOWN ... ARROW CONNECTS ONTO THE AMELIA ... A DOUBLE

plays.desc_en: GEN dives TheShy top; Canyon's Q misses so TheShy survives, but GEN takes the top turret it was after.
plays.quote: it again, but now The Shy has to try and ... to survive this dive ... that Q is going to miss here from

plays.quote: anything too crazy right now. Chovy just ... It's a pretty defensive play here from ... Chovy. Just grabbing this wave as it

plays.desc_en: IG backs off as Canyon enters the river, and GEN looks for a quick play.
plays.quote: Canyon moves into that river, and that ... is I.G.'s signal to leave

plays.desc_ko: 루키가 귀환하자 젠지가 전령을 시작하고 캐니언이 오랫동안 전령을 침. 그러나 교전이 벌어지며 해설은 나중에 전령이 실제로 처치되지 않았다고 정정.
plays.desc_en: With Rookie recalling, GEN starts Rift Herald and Canyon hits it for a long time, but a fight breaks out and the casters later correct that it was never taken.
plays.quote: this Rift Herald shortly ... Canyon on this Rift Herald is ... Rift Herald wasn't actually taken

plays.desc_en: Rookie teleports top off a river ward and, masked by Paranoia, flanks behind Canyon into GEN's backline; Duro's Encore misses and TheShy joins to help finish with The Equalizer. Rookie survives as Ruler falls for a bounty and Duro dies too, giving IG a 2-for-1.
plays.quote: teleport in though as Rookie does ... THAT BACK LINE. THE ENCORE GOES ... SURVIVES. THE SHUTDOWN ONTO RULER, AND

plays.desc_en: Near Herald, Ruler's arrow hits an unshielded Nocturne, who survives through Meiko's Cleansing Flame and uses Paranoia defensively, while Chovy finishes the cornered Meiko with Orb of Deception.
plays.quote: Gen.G thinking about trying to find an ... arrow is going to connect, AND THERE IS ... NO SPELL SHIELD HERE FOR THE NOCTURNE

plays.desc_ko: 교전 직후 캐니언이 두 번째 드래곤(마법공학)을 가져가려 하고, 해설은 견제 없이 가져갈 수 있어 보인다고 서술.
plays.desc_en: Right after the fight, Canyon moves to take the second dragon, a Hextech, which looks uncontested.
plays.quote: in this moment as Canyon wanting to grab ... the second Drake for Gen.G ... Gen.G look to be able to take it without

plays.desc_en: GEN keeps sieging top as Ruler lands many arrows, and IG's second top-side turret falls despite their defense.
plays.quote: lock that one down as this siege is just ... continuing. Ruler getting a lot of ... turret going down here for IG towards

plays.desc_ko: IG가 지아치의 궁극기(컬링)로 젠지를 밀어내고, 더샤이의 이퀄라이저로 웨이브를 정리해 시간을 벌며 포탑을 수비. 해설은 '좋은 수비 플레이'라고 평가했지만 두 번째 포탑은 결국 파괴됨.
plays.desc_en: IG pushes GEN back with JiaQi's The Culling and clears with TheShy's The Equalizer to buy time, a good defensive play per the casters, but the second turret still falls.
plays.quote: arrows as the culling is going to try ... equalizer just clear out the wave, buy ... IG just defending with culling and

plays.desc_ko: 웨이가 패러노이아를 사용했지만 캐니언의 킥(리 신 궁극기)에 밀려남. 해설은 두 정글러의 궁극기 교환으로 정리하고 서로 자리를 다시 잡는다고 서술.
plays.desc_en: Wei uses Paranoia but is kicked away by Canyon's Dragon's Rage, and both junglers reset after trading ultimates.
plays.quote: paranoia does come on out here as ... he's just kicked away ... a trade of ultimates between our two

plays.desc_en: After the ultimate exchange, GEN takes the Scuttle Crab while Canyon looks for a Q.
plays.quote: for a cheeky queue as that is just going ... to be the crab's killed by Gen.G

plays.desc_ko: 정글 궁극기 교환 직후 젠지가 곧바로 미드로 진입. 지아치가 큰 피해를 입고 메이코가 처치됨. 지아치는 점멸·컬링을 쓰고 배리어로 간신히 생존, 기인의 니들워크가 포탑 아래 후열에 닿았지만 아주 조금 모자람. 캐니언은 빠져나왔고 루키는 도망치다 캐니언과 싸움. 해설은 녹턴 궁 없는 틈에 쵸비가 전진해 첫 킬(메이코)을 냈다고 회고.
plays.desc_en: GEN dives mid immediately, chunking JiaQi and killing Meiko; JiaQi burns Flash and The Culling and barely survives with Barrier while Kiin's Snip Snip! falls just short. Canyon escapes and fights a fleeing Rookie, with Chovy having stepped up for the first kill without Paranoia available.
plays.quote: WHAT THE HECK IS THIS? JOCHI TAKING SO ... MEKA IS JUST DEAD ... BARRIER TO KEEP HIMSELF ALIVE

plays.desc_ko: 미드 웨이브 근처에서 IG가 앞으로 나서려 함. 웨이(녹턴)가 진입했지만 이미 캐니언이 자리잡고 있어 탈출로가 없음을 늦게 깨닫고 처치됨. 더샤이의 텔레포트도 원하던 결과가 아니었다는 서술. 해설은 녹턴이 자신의 힘을 과대평가했다고 회고.
plays.desc_en: IG steps up near the mid wave, but Wei (Nocturne) realizes too late Canyon has cut off his escape and dies, while TheShy's Teleport doesn't pay off; the casters say Nocturne overrated his strength.
plays.quote: IG trying ... to go forward, but GenG collapsing ... LATE, REALIZES THERE'S NO EXIT, AND DOWN

plays.desc_ko: 젠지가 IG의 전진을 읽고 협공. 캐니언이 녹턴을 잡은 뒤 루키를 노려 후열로 파고들고, 메이코의 킥(밀리오 E)이 공간을 벌었지만 IG는 두 명만 살아남음. 기인도 이 교전을 위해 텔레포트로 합류해 루키를 노림. 회고: 루키가 내려오자 쵸비가 즉시 읽고 합류.
